Evan P.: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need owners + close dates for the scaling incident action items: runbook, autoscaler tuning, telemetry dashboard, and a monthly pattern review. I'll open tickets, please claim and add ETAs.

Maya R.: I can take the runbook updates. ETA: 2026-03-26. Assign RM-7011 to me and I9ll add a short checklist.

Tom S.: I'll own autoscaler tuning. Need a staging canary window. Tentative canary: 2026-03-25 00:00-02:00 UTC. Creating RM-7012.

Rhea K.: I'll add telemetry/dashboards and set up the monthly incident-pattern review. RM-7013 created. Will include queries for memory + queue length.
